Your Sitting Foundation

(Foot, Hip & Shoulder Alignment)
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }},

Today is the base everything else builds on: how you actually sit. Most of us sit badly for 8+ hours a day without noticing. These four checks take 30 seconds.

Today's 4 checks

Feet flat on the floor
Not crossed, not tucked under the chair.
Hips all the way back
Sit on your sit bones, not your tailbone.
Shoulders back and down
Away from your ears, relaxed rather than pulled.
Ears over shoulders
Think tall, not stiff.
